about: related in either direction, any relation type
sql: SELECT o.id FROM objects o WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relations r WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((r.src_id = ? AND r.dst_id = o.id) OR (r.dst_id = ? AND r.src_id = o.id))) ORDER BY o.updated_at DESC, o.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
